verdict.rationale: Maritime's docs say each agent gets its own micro-VM and that secrets are injected only into that agent's VM. That implies per-agent VM separation. However, these are passing mentions on a framework page and the configuration page, not a documented isolation or security boundary model. Missing for 10: a dedicated security/isolation architecture doc describing the microVM technology and its guarantees, documentation of the boundary between tenant sandboxes and customer or host systems (network and egress isolation), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on a documented hard isolation boundary (microVM or equivalent) between sandboxes and my systems

citations.quote: its own always-on micro-VM in the cloud
injected only into that agent's VM
